# feat(hfp-011): upload a plain-text transcript to a Project

## Task

Let a researcher upload a `.txt` transcript into the open Project. The server stores the transcript, parses it into segments and creates Participants for the speakers. The dashboard then shows it and can analyse it. This is the second API slice after projects (HFP-005), and the first real way to put data into the app.

This is large. Split it into an API issue and an app issue before starting, if that helps.

## Parent Story

Hosted-first pivot (ADR 0001), data model (ADR 0004), API (ADR 0005). Follows HFP-001 (parser) and HFP-005 (projects API).

## Blocked by

- HFP-008 (Project delete fails once segments exist)
- HFP-009 (XSS through `v-html` in the transcript view)
- HFP-010 (decision on participant names in text)

## Acceptance Criteria

### API
- [ ] `POST /api/projects/:id/transcripts` accepts the text and filename. It returns 404 for a Project the user doesn't own and 400 for empty text or text over a size limit (to be chosen).
- [ ] The server parses the text into segments, as ADR 0004 requires. `parsePlainTextTranscript` is shared between app and server rather than copied.
- [ ] Inserts run in one transaction: transcript (`raw_text`, `content_hash`, `original_filename`, `source = 'upload'`), Participants per new speaker label (pseudonymous `label`), and segments with `ordinal`, `start_char` / `end_char` and `participant_id`.
- [ ] Every insert passes the Project's `project_id`, after checking that the user owns the Project (HFP-006 follow-up).
- [ ] Same `content_hash` as an existing transcript in the Project → the response says it is already uploaded (ADR 0004).
- [ ] `GET /api/projects/:id/transcripts` lists the Project's transcripts; `GET .../transcripts/:tid` returns one with its segments.
- [ ] Server tests run against `airgap_test` (the same pattern as `projects.spec.ts`).
- [ ] Applies HFP-010's decision on names.

### App
- [ ] `FileDropzone` accepts `.txt` only (it currently accepts audio/video) and is shown on the dashboard for the open Project.
- [ ] After upload, the dashboard shows the Project's transcripts. Choosing one loads its segments and can start analysis (`analyzeSegments`).
- [ ] Upload shows progress or pending state, a duplicate warning, and errors.
- [ ] Specs for the API client, store and components.

### Docs
- [ ] Personal data added by this slice (transcript text, speaker names) is documented.
- [ ] `notes/progress.md` entry and `notes/task-list.md` updated.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-human` (the owner writes the SQL and the API plumbing from this slice on)
